document.abstract: UHD, HDR, WCG, HFR are bound to be powerful creative tools with which to engage the viewer. Such acronyms (and would-be logos) could also prove to be influential marketing aids. But how justified would standards bodies, content creators, and distributors be in thinking of each feature as independent? — This paper will provide principles of applied vision science to quantify the extent of interdependence of luminance, field—of-view, color perception, and temporal sensitivity. This paper will also identify situations in which luminance, color, and frame rate should perhaps be considered in concert rather than as independent creative dials.
